title: rhinanthus glacialis subsp. subalpinus
intro: Rhinanthus glacialis subsp. subalpinus, commonly known as Alpine Ramping Fumitory, is a rare and endangered plant species found in the mountainous regions of Europe. As a medicinal plant, it has been traditionally used for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it beneficial for treating various health issues, such as respiratory problems, fever, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Ramping Fumitory include its ability to reduce inflammation, stimulate the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
